fields.reasoning: The question comes from plan review round 3, finding f1, which the critic confirmed. run-brief-files' statement and the decision brief-files-and-invoke-placement name five session-directory forms. The round-2 revision added the two checks-step fixer and verifier forms to stop directories colliding, yet the acceptance tests only three forms. A leaf fixer and the change set fixer both carry the role fixer in one cycle, so they are the likeliest collision and need a test most. Extending the acceptance is the fix the finding asks for. It needs no change to the statement or the scheme, and it stays inside brief_test.go, the file the leaf already touches, so it is the narrowest answer that fits the change set's intent.
fields.statement: run-brief-files' TestSessionDir acceptance covers all five session-directory forms its statement names. To the 'all names different' case add, within one cycle of a checks step: a leaf fixer and a leaf verifier of the same leaf at one attempt (<role>-<leaf>-<cycle>-<attempt>), the same leaf fixer at attempt 2, and the change set fixer at attempts 1 and 2 (fixer-<cycle>-<attempt>). The leaf fixer and the change set fixer of one cycle and attempt must get distinct directories, and none of these may equal a check's or critic's directory of that cycle. The leaf's statement and the rest of its acceptance stay as they are.
